ANGLE (NVIDIA Corporation, NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB/PCIe/SSE2, OpenGL ES 3.2)

method: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 on the actual production pipeline. Two warm updates/frames, five shadow updates, eight cached main frames. App RAF suspended only for measurement; instrument pose/camera verified unchanged afterward.
limits: Diagnostic timings on a shared Slurm GPU allocation; actual EGL adapter/process isolation is unverified. GPU component times on the reported GPU/ANGLE EGL setup, not end-to-end frame rate or a browser/device performance guarantee. Shadow updates are cached until the instrument pose changes. Earlier prototype timings are not used as comparative performance evidence.
